caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a two-section design. The upper section consists of two tall compartments with four doors, two of which are open to reveal shelves inside; these doors have rectangular inset panels and brass-colored hinges. The lower section is composed of four drawers arranged in two rows, each drawer featuring a round wooden knob handle. The cabinet stands on four tapered legs. The entire piece is rendered in shades of brown, representing wood grain, and the drawing is set against a plain, light beige background. There is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "Paul Childers."
title: Shaker Cabinet
